fixed.summary: One rem in a class string is the body type step, 14 px, as the UI documentation says; the default theme left it at 16. A bracketed rem length (`w-[17.143rem]`, `text-[0.857rem]`) now draws at the documented size, the same as the theme step for that length (`w-60`, `text-xs`), where it drew 14% larger. The engine's components written with bracketed rems draw at their designed sizes; a game's own `[…rem]` classes do too. A game's pack sets its own with the theme's `rem`.
